checked_items.zh: 检查了 lark-client.ts（src/host/）中的凭据存取流程：appSecret 通过 ctx.credentials 安全存储，config.json 仅存凭据引用键名（credentialRef），凭据本身不落盘至配置文件。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the credential storage flow in lark-client.ts (src/host/): appSecret is stored securely via ctx.credentials, config.json only stores the credential reference key name (credentialRef), and the credentials themselves are never written to disk in the config file.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 auth-setup.ts（src/host/）中的扫码认证流程：凭据通过 OAuth device-code 流获取后直接写入 ctx.credentials，不经过日志或临时文件。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the QR code authentication flow in auth-setup.ts (src/host/): credentials obtained via the OAuth device-code flow are written directly to ctx.credentials, without passing through logs or temporary files.

checked_items.zh: 未发现硬编码密钥、API Token 或敏感路径读取（如 ~/.ssh、.aws/credentials）。诊断包服务（diagnostics-service.ts）对凭据做脱敏处理。
checked_items.en: No hardcoded secrets, API tokens, or sensitive path reads (e.g., ~/.ssh, .aws/credentials) were found. The diagnostics package service (diagnostics-service.ts) redacts credentials.

evidence.zh: 未检出凭据读取与外发组合。插件凭据仅存于 ctx.credentials 安全存储，运行时仅用于构造飞书客户端（buildLarkClient），不存在读取 ~/.ssh 等敏感路径后再外发的代码路径。脚本 restart-dsh.sh 仅探测本地回环地址，不参与运行时凭据处理。
evidence.en: No combination of credential read and outbound exfiltration detected. Plugin credentials are stored only in the ctx.credentials secure store and are used at runtime solely to construct the Feishu client (buildLarkClient); there is no code path that reads sensitive paths like ~/.ssh and then exfiltrates. The script restart-dsh.sh only probes the local loopback address and is not involved in runtime credential handling.

checked_items.en: Checked all network endpoints: the plugin communicates only with official Feishu APIs (open.feishu.cn, open.larksuite.com, accounts.feishu.cn, accounts.larksuite.com) via @larksuiteoapi/node-sdk and the global fetch, with no undeclared outbound connections.

checked_items.en: Checked the outbound network patterns: the device-code flow in auth-setup.ts communicates with Feishu OAuth endpoints; all SDK calls in lark-client.ts point to Feishu REST APIs. No raw IP connections, no DNS tunneling, and no webhook callbacks to non-official endpoints.

checked_items.zh: 凭据（appSecret）仅通过 SDK 在内存中传给飞书，不落盘、不写入日志，诊断包做脱敏处理。

checked_items.en: Checked the dependency manifest: all runtime dependencies are @larksuiteoapi/node-sdk (official Feishu SDK), axios, fflate, qrcode, and qrcode-terminal. peerDependencies are the @deepseek-ai/dsh-* series (provided by the host dsh). No typosquatting-suspect package names.
